mentions.name: zk-STARK zero-knowledge proof system
mentions.description: A zero-knowledge proof system (zk-STARK) that runs on Android, macOS, Linux, and WebAssembly, with Vulkan/CUDA backends (Metal support coming). Current work focuses on optimizing composition polynomial evaluation, which is currently suboptimal.
mentions.problem: Composition polynomial evaluation is currently suboptimal and is the focus of ongoing optimization.
mentions.source_excerpt: first order zero knowledge proof system (zk-stark), it works on android, macos, linux, webassembly, vulkan/cuda backend (metal coming), but the composition polynomial evaluation is suboptimal so i am working on that now
